# 0. Prepare environment and Load data 
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(khroma)
library(ggrepel)

# load Pangenome Analysis Output data 
## Panaroo
gene_presence_absence_Panaroo <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/500_Samples/13.Pangenome_analysis/13.1.Panaroo/gene_presence_absence.csv")
## Roary
gene_presence_absence_Roary <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/500_Samples/13.Pangenome_analysis/13.2.ROARY/gene_presence_absence.csv")
## Panaroo + Clarc
gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/500_Samples/13.Pangenome_analysis/13.3.Panaroo_CLARC/clarc_condensed_presence_absence.csv")
## Roary + Clarc
gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/500_Samples/13.Pangenome_analysis/13.4.ROARY_CLARC/clarc_condensed_presence_absence.csv")

# load Pyseer Output data 
## Panaroo
PanGWAS_Panaroo <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/500_Samples/15.2.Subanalysis_1/16.2.1.Fasttree/PanGWAS_Panaroo_phylo_Fasttree.txt")
## Roary
PanGWAS_Roary <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/500_Samples/15.3.Subanalysis_2/PanGWAS_Roary_Fasttree.txt")
## Panaroo + Clarc
PanGWAS_Panaroo_Clarc <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/500_Samples/15.3.Subanalysis_2/PanGWAS_Panaroo_CLARC_Fasttree.txt")
## Roary + Clarc
PanGWAS_Roary_Clarc <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/500_Samples/15.3.Subanalysis_2/PanGWAS_Roary_CLARC_Fasttree.txt")
```

# 1. Compare pangenome tool outputs
## 1.0. Prepare data
```{r}
# Format data
## Panaroo
gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_V1 <- gene_presence_absence_Panaroo|>
  select(Gene, contains("SRR"))|> 
  mutate(across(contains("SRR"), ~ ifelse(. == "", "0", "1")))|>
  mutate(af = rowSums(across(contains("SRR")) == "1") / ncol(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo|>select(contains("SRR")))) |>
  mutate(Category= ifelse(af<0.95, "accessory", "core"))
gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_V2 <- gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_V1|> filter(af>=0.05)
gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Accessory <- gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_V2|>
  filter(Category =="accessory")
gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Core <- gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_V2|>
  filter(Category =="core")
## Roary
gene_presence_absence_Roary_V1 <- gene_presence_absence_Roary|>
  select(Gene, contains("SRR"))|> 
  mutate(across(contains("SRR"), ~ ifelse(. == "", "0", "1")))|>
  mutate(af = rowSums(across(contains("SRR")) == "1") / ncol(gene_presence_absence_Roary|>select(contains("SRR"))))  |>
  mutate(Category= ifelse(af<0.95, "accessory", "core"))
gene_presence_absence_Roary_V2 <- gene_presence_absence_Roary_V1 |> filter(af>=0.05)
gene_presence_absence_Roary_Accessory <- gene_presence_absence_Roary_V2|>
  filter(Category =="accessory")
gene_presence_absence_Roary_Core <- gene_presence_absence_Roary_V2|>
  filter(Category =="core")
## Panaroo + CLARC
gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2 <- as.data.frame(t(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc))
colnames(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2) <- gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2[1, ]
gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2 <- gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2[-1,]
gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2 <-gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2 |>
  mutate(Gene = row.names(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2))|>
  select(Gene, everything())
row.names(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2) <- NULL
gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V1 <- gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2|>
  mutate(af = rowSums(across(contains("SRR")) == "1") / ncol(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2|>select(contains("SRR")))) |>
  mutate(Category= ifelse(af<0.95, "accessory", "core"))
gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2 <- gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V1 |> filter(af>=0.05)
gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_Accessory <- gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2|>
  filter(Category =="accessory")
gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_Core <- gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2|>
  filter(Category =="core")
## Roary + CLARC
gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2 <- as.data.frame(t(gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc))
colnames(gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2) <- gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2[1, ]
gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2 <- gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2[-1,]
gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2 <-gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2 |>
  mutate(Gene = row.names(gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2))|>
  select(Gene, everything())
row.names(gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2) <- NULL
gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V1 <- gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2|>
  mutate(af = rowSums(across(contains("SRR")) == "1") / ncol(gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2|>select(contains("SRR")))) |>
  mutate(Category= ifelse(af<0.95, "accessory", "core"))
gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2 <- gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V1 |> filter(af>=0.05)
gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_Accessory <- gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2|>
  filter(Category =="accessory")
gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_Core <- gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2|>
  filter(Category =="core")
# # Check that there is the sample number of samples across outputs of each tools
# ncol(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_V2)
# ncol(gene_presence_absence_Roary_V2)
# ncol(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2)
# ncol(gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2)
gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_V2 <- gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_V2 |>  select(colnames(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2))
gene_presence_absence_Roary_V2 <- gene_presence_absence_Roary_V2 |>  select(colnames(gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2))

# Join dataframes
gene_presence_absence_All_Tools <-rbind(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_V2 |> mutate(Tool = "Panaroo"),
      gene_presence_absence_Roary_V2 |> mutate(Tool = "Roary"),
      gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_V2 |> mutate(Tool = "Panaroo + CLARC"),
      gene_presence_absence_Roary_Clarc_V2 |> mutate(Tool = "Roary + CLARC"))
```
## 1.1. Plot Accessory and core gene counts across Tools
```{r}
# Accessory + Core
gene_presence_absence_All_Tools |>
  mutate(Category= factor(Category, levels= c("core", "accessory")))|>
  group_by(Category, Tool) |>
  summarise(N=n())|>
  ggplot(aes(x = Tool, y = N, fill = Tool)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(Category~., dir = "v")+
  labs(x = "Tool", y = "Count (N)", title = "Accessory and Core Gene Counts by Tool") +
  theme_bw() +
  ylim(0, 2000)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("indianred4", "darkolivegreen", "lightgoldenrod", "darkslategrey"))+
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=",N)), vjust = -0.5, color = "black", size = 4)
```

## 1.2. Compare Panaroo and Roary Outputs
## 1.2.1. Plot Gene overlap between Panaroo and Roary
```{r}
library(circlize)
df <- data.frame(from = c("Panaroo Core", "Panaroo Core", "Panaroo Core", "Panaroo Accessory", "Panaroo Accessory", "Panaroo Accessory", "No Panaroo" , "No Panaroo"),
           to = c("Roary Core", "Roary Accessory", "No Roary", "Roary Core", "Roary Accessory", "No Roary",  "Roary Core", "Roary Accessory"),
           value = c(nrow(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Core |> filter(Gene %in% gene_presence_absence_Roary_Core$Gene)),
                     nrow(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Core |> filter(Gene %in% gene_presence_absence_Roary_Accessory$Gene)),
                     nrow(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Core |> filter(! Gene %in% gene_presence_absence_Roary_V2$Gene)),
                     nrow(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Accessory |> filter(Gene %in% gene_presence_absence_Roary_Core$Gene)),
                     nrow(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Accessory |> filter(Gene %in% gene_presence_absence_Roary_Accessory$Gene)),
                     nrow(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Accessory |> filter(! Gene %in% gene_presence_absence_Roary_V2$Gene)),
                     nrow(gene_presence_absence_Roary_Core |> filter(Gene %in% gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_V2$Gene)),
                     nrow(gene_presence_absence_Roary_Accessory |> filter(! Gene %in% gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_V2$Gene))))

grid.col = c("Panaroo Core" = "indianred4", "Panaroo Accessory" = "indianred", "Roary Core" = "lightgoldenrod3","Roary Accessory" = "lightgoldenrod",
    "No Panaroo" =  "#00000000", "No Roary" =  "#00000000")

col_mat = c("steelblue4", "indianred4", "#00000000",  "indianred",  "lightsteelblue4", "#00000000", "#00000000","#00000000")

circos.par(start.degree = -20, clock.wise = T)
chordDiagram(
  df, 
  grid.col = grid.col, 
  col = col_mat,  
  annotationTrack =  c("grid"),
    preAllocateTracks = list(
        track.height = mm_h(6),
        track.margin = c( mm_h(1), 0)))
names <- c("Core", "Accessory", "", "Core", "Accessory", "")
# Add sector labels with customized text position and styling
i <- 0
for(si in get.all.sector.index()) {
  i= i+1
    xlim = get.cell.meta.data("xlim", sector.index = si, track.index = 1)
    ylim = get.cell.meta.data("ylim", sector.index = si, track.index = 1)
    circos.text(mean(xlim), mean(ylim), names[i], sector.index = si, track.index = 2, 
      facing = "bending.inside", niceFacing = TRUE, col = "black", cex = 0.8)
}
highlight.sector(c("Roary Core" , "Roary Accessory" ), track.index = 1, col = "lemonchiffon", 
    text = "Roary", cex = 1, text.col = "black", niceFacing = TRUE)
highlight.sector(c("Panaroo Core" , "Panaroo Accessory" ), track.index = 1, col = "indianred4", 
    text = "Panaroo", cex = 1, text.col = "white", niceFacing = TRUE)
circos.clear()
```

## 1.2.2. Plot the AF of Genes that overlap between Panaroo and Roary
```{r}
# prepare data
Roary_Panaroo_Shared_df <- left_join(gene_presence_absence_Roary_V1|>
  filter(Gene %in% gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_V1$Gene)|>
  select(Gene, af)|>
  rename("Roary_af"="af"),
  gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_V1 |>
  select(Gene, af)|>
  rename("Panaroo_af"="af")) |>
  mutate(Category= ifelse(Roary_af >= 0.95, 
                          ifelse(Panaroo_af >= 0.95, "Core Both", "Roary Core"), 
                          ifelse(Panaroo_af >= 0.95, "Panaroo Core", 
                                 ifelse(Roary_af < 0.05, 
                                        ifelse(Panaroo_af < 0.05, "Exclude Both", "Panaroo Accessory"), 
                                        ifelse(Panaroo_af < 0.05, "Roary Accessory", "Accessory Both")))))|>
  mutate(Category= factor(Category, levels= c("Core Both", "Roary Core", "Panaroo Core", "Accessory Both", "Roary Accessory", "Panaroo Accessory", "Exclude Both")))

# Plot
Roary_Panaroo_Shared_df|>
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x=Panaroo_af, y= Roary_af, color = Category))+
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "grey", linetype = "dashed", size = 1)+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("Roary MAF")+
  xlab("Panaroo MAF")+
  ggtitle("MAF of Genes overlapping between Panaroo and Roary")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("steelblue4", "lightgoldenrod3", "indianred4", "lightsteelblue4", "lightgoldenrod", "indianred", "grey80"))
  
```


## 1.3. PLOT AF change among accessory genes refined by CLARC
### 1.3.1. Panaroo vs Panaroo + CLARC
```{r}
# PLOT AF among accessory genes that are NOT re-defined by CLARC
Panaroo_CLARC_SAME_COGS_df <- left_join(gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_Accessory |>
  mutate(Gene = str_replace_all(Gene, "\\.\\.\\.", "~~~")) |>
  filter(Gene %in% gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Accessory$Gene)|>
  select(Gene, af)|>
  rename("Panaroo_CLARC_af"="af"),
  gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Accessory |>
  select(Gene, af)|>
  rename("Panaroo_af"="af"))
Panaroo_CLARC_SAME_COGS_df|>
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x=Panaroo_af, y= Panaroo_CLARC_af))+
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("Panaroo MAF")+
  ylab("Panaroo + CLARC MAF")

# PLOT AF change from CLARC among accessory genes
Panaroo_CLARC_reassign_COGS_df <- gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_Accessory |>
  mutate(Gene = str_replace_all(Gene, "\\.\\.\\.", "~~~")) |>
  filter(! Gene %in% gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Accessory$Gene)|>
  select(Gene, af) |> 
  rename("ID"="Gene")|>
  mutate(Gene= NA )
Panaroo_CLARC_reassign_COGS_df <- Panaroo_CLARC_reassign_COGS_df|>
  mutate(Cluster= as.factor(1:nrow(Panaroo_CLARC_reassign_COGS_df)))

Reassigned_IDs_split <- Panaroo_CLARC_reassign_COGS_df |>
  separate_rows(ID, sep="\\.")|>
  pull(ID)

Panaroo_reassign_COGS_df <- left_join(
gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Accessory |>
  mutate(Gene = str_replace_all(Gene, "~~~", "..."))|>
  filter(! Gene %in% gene_presence_absence_Panaroo_Clarc_Accessory$Gene)|>
  select(Gene, af)|>
  mutate(Reassigned_Category = ifelse(Gene %in% Reassigned_IDs_split, "accessory", "core")), Panaroo_CLARC_reassign_COGS_df |>
  mutate(Original_ID = ID) |>   
  separate_rows(ID, sep = "\\.")|>
  select(Original_ID, ID, Cluster)|>
  rename("Gene"="ID", "ID" = "Original_ID")|>
  filter(Gene != "")) 

p_df_Panaroo <- rbind(Panaroo_reassign_COGS_df  |> mutate(Type = "Original Panaroo COG"), 
      Panaroo_CLARC_reassign_COGS_df |> mutate(Type = "CLARC re-defined", Reassigned_Category = "accessory"))

p_df_Panaroo |>
  filter(Reassigned_Category == "accessory") |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = Cluster, y = af, color = Type)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(x = Cluster, y = af, label = Gene), 
                  size = 2.5, color = "black", 
                  box.padding = 0.3,  # Adjust padding around labels
                  point.padding = 0.2, # Adjust padding around points
                  segment.size = 0.2,  # Line size between point and label
                  max.overlaps = 10) + # Limits maximum label overlap
  ylab("Minor Allele Frequency (MAF)") +
  xlab("COG Cluster") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = color("light")(6)) +
  ylim(0, 1)

# Which COGs are redefined by CLARC as core ?
Panaroo_reassign_COGS_df |> arrange(Reassigned_Category, Cluster)
```

```{r}
p_df_Roary |>

                  size = 2.5, color = "black",

                  point.padding = 0.2, # Adjust padding around points
                  segment.size = 0.2,  # Line size between point and label
                  max.overlaps = 10) + # Limits maximum label overlap
  ylab("Minor Allele Frequency (MAF)") +
  xlab("COG Cluster") +

# Which COGs are redefined by CLARC as core ?
Roary_reassign_COGS_df |> arrange(Reassigned_Category, Cluster)
Roary_reassign_COGS_df |> filter( Reassigned_Category == "accessory")
```

# 2. Compare Pan-GWAS results
## 2.0. Prepare data
```{r}
# Add significance column, with bonferonni correction for multiple testing
PanGWAS_Panaroo <- PanGWAS_Panaroo |> 
  mutate(significance = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(PanGWAS_Panaroo), "significant", "not significant"))|>
  mutate(PanGWAS_Roary = factor(significance, levels= c("significant", "not significant"))) |>
  filter(af>=0.05)
PanGWAS_Roary <- PanGWAS_Roary  |> 
  mutate(significance = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(PanGWAS_Roary), "significant", "not significant"))|> 
  mutate(significance = factor(significance, levels= c("significant", "not significant")))
PanGWAS_Panaroo_Clarc <- PanGWAS_Panaroo_Clarc |> 
  mutate(significance = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(PanGWAS_Panaroo_Clarc), "significant", "not significant"))|> 
  mutate(significance = factor(significance, levels= c("significant", "not significant")))
PanGWAS_Roary_Clarc <- PanGWAS_Roary_Clarc |> 
  mutate(significance = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(PanGWAS_Roary_Clarc), "significant", "not significant"))|> 
  mutate(significance = factor(significance, levels= c("significant", "not significant")))
```
## 2.1. Compare Panaroo and Roary
```{r}
## prepare data
PanGWAS_Panaroo_Shared <- PanGWAS_Panaroo[which(PanGWAS_Panaroo$variant %in% PanGWAS_Roary$variant),]
PanGWAS_Roary_Shared <- PanGWAS_Roary[which(PanGWAS_Roary$variant %in% PanGWAS_Panaroo$variant),]
colnames(PanGWAS_Panaroo_Shared) <- c("variant", paste0("Panaroo_",colnames(PanGWAS_Panaroo_Shared)[-1]))
colnames(PanGWAS_Roary_Shared) <- c("variant", paste0("Roary_",colnames(PanGWAS_Roary_Shared)[-1]))
PanGWAS_Panaroo_Roary_Shared <- left_join(PanGWAS_Panaroo_Shared, PanGWAS_Roary_Shared)
nrow(PanGWAS_Panaroo_Roary_Shared)
## Plot
### unADJUSTED P-VALUE

cor_test <- cor.test(PanGWAS_Panaroo_Roary_Shared$Roary_filter.pvalue, 
                     PanGWAS_Panaroo_Roary_Shared$Panaroo_filter.pvalue, 
                     method = "pearson")
cor_coef <- cor_test$estimate
p_value <- cor_test$p.value
PanGWAS_Panaroo_Roary_Shared |>
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x=Roary_filter.pvalue, y= Panaroo_filter.pvalue))+
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "grey", linetype = "dashed", size = 1)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05/nrow(PanGWAS_Roary), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1)+
  geom_vline(xintercept= 0.05/nrow(PanGWAS_Panaroo), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1)+
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("Roary unadjusted p-value")+
  ylab("Panaroo unadjusted p-value")+
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.9, y = 1, # Adjust position as needed
    label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_coef, 2), 
                   "\nP = ", format.pval(p_value, digits = 2)),
    color = "red",
    size = 5
  )+
  ggtitle("Unadjusted p-value of Genes overlapping between Panaroo and Roary")

### ADJUSTED P-VALUE
cor_test2 <- cor.test(PanGWAS_Panaroo_Roary_Shared$Roary_lrt.pvalue, 
                     PanGWAS_Panaroo_Roary_Shared$Panaroo_lrt.pvalue, 
                     method = "pearson")
cor_coef2 <- cor_test2$estimate
p_value2 <- cor_test2$p.value
PanGWAS_Panaroo_Roary_Shared |>
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x=Roary_lrt.pvalue, y= Panaroo_lrt.pvalue))+
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", size = 1)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05/nrow(PanGWAS_Roary), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1)+
  geom_vline(xintercept= 0.05/nrow(PanGWAS_Panaroo), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1)+
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("Roary unadjusted p-value")+
  ylab("Panaroo unadjusted p-value")+
  annotate( "text",
    x = 0.9, y = 1, # Adjust position as needed
    label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_coef2, 2), 
                   "\nP = ", format.pval(p_value2, digits = 2)),
    color = "red",
    size = 5)+
```

### 2.2.2. Compare re-defined genes
```{r}
CLARC_redefined_Panaroo_genes <-  p_df_Panaroo |>
  filter(Reassigned_Category == "accessory")|>
  filter(! is.na(Gene))|>
  mutate(ID = str_replace_all(ID, "\\.", "-"))

df_refined_Panaroo_CLARC_pvalue <- rbind(
  left_join(PanGWAS_Panaroo |> 
  filter(variant %in% CLARC_redefined_Panaroo_genes$Gene)|>
  select(variant, filter.pvalue, lrt.pvalue, significance)|>
  mutate(Tool= "Panaroo"), 
   CLARC_redefined_Panaroo_genes |> 
    select(Gene, Cluster)|> 
    rename("variant" = "Gene")), 
  left_join(PanGWAS_Panaroo_Clarc |>
  filter(variant %in% CLARC_redefined_Panaroo_genes$ID)|>
  select(variant, filter.pvalue, lrt.pvalue, significance)|>
  mutate(Tool= "Panaroo+CLARC"), 
  CLARC_redefined_Panaroo_genes |> 
    select(ID, Cluster)|> 
    rename("variant" = "ID")))|>
  mutate(Gene= ifelse(Tool== "Panaroo", variant, NA))
# Plot 
# Unadjusted
df_refined_Panaroo_CLARC_pvalue |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = Cluster, y = filter.pvalue, color = Tool)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(x = Cluster, y = filter.pvalue, label = Gene), 
                  size = 2.5, color = "black", 
                  box.padding = 0.3,  # Adjust padding around labels
                  point.padding = 0.2, # Adjust padding around points
                  segment.size = 0.2,  # Line size between point and label
                  max.overlaps = 10) + # Limits maximum label overlap
  ylab("Unadjusted p-value") +
  xlab("COG Cluster") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = color("light")(6))  +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05/nrow(PanGWAS_Roary), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1)+
  geom_hline(yintercept= 0.05/nrow(PanGWAS_Roary_Clarc), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1)+
  scale_y_log10()


# Adjusted

  geom_point(aes(x = Cluster, y = lrt.pvalue, color = Tool)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(x = Cluster, y = lrt.pvalue, label = Gene),

                  point.padding = 0.2, # Adjust padding around points
```
